verdict.rationale: Nothing in the Stagehand docs pack states a captcha stance: there is no automatic solving, no human-in-the-loop fallback, and no explicit non-support statement. The only mention is a single community remark praising "built in proxies and captcha." That remark is undocumented and likely refers to the Browserbase hosting platform rather than Stagehand itself, so it cannot stand in for the documented stance the story requires.
